provenance.note: The book prints Kaliber bis 8 mm. D.14.13 (Teil D, PDF p. 84) allows ZG 4 modifiziert with other semi-automatic rifles (10 kg, any magnification, trigger from 1000 g, forend up to 76 mm, 4 x 6 s for the scoring shots), scored separately. It has the distance, shots and face of this record and no record of its own. The score has 4 timed series of 8 s; the sighting series has 5 min. A modified class (D.14.13) allows 10 kg, any magnification, a 1000 g trigger and 6 s series and is scored separately.
